title: RNA Extraction from Brain Stem Tissue for Rabies Diagnosis by RT-PCR
author: Crystal M. Gigante
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.n4udgww

steps.title: Prepare Workspace
steps.instruction: Prepare the Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Thaw frozen samples just prior to testing.
Clean the BSC work surface using RNase Away® and 70% ethanol.
Layout plastic-lined absorbent work pad(s) in the hood.
Place reagents, supplies, and samples in the BSC.

steps.title: Homogenize Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Thoroughly homogenize brain pieces to ensure maximum RNA yield.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize tissue using a bead beater, micro tissue grinder, or sterile applicator stick.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the homogenate to isolate the RNA-containing supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Let the sample sit for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge the sample at 10,000–16,000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear, pink supernatant to a new sterile microcentrifuge tube, avoiding lipids and solid tissue.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 300 μl of supernatant for standard samples.
Transfer 600 μl of supernatant for very little tissue (e.g., small bat), deteriorated tissue, or non-brain tissue.
Store the remaining homogenate in a screw-top tube at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol Mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the supernatant with ethanol to prepare for column binding.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 95–100% ethanol to the homogenate supernatant (e.g., 300 μl ethanol to 300 μl TRIzol-supernatant).
Mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load the ethanol-supernatant mixture onto a Zymo-Spin™ IIC Column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the mixture to the column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000–16,000 × g for 1 minute until liquid has passed through.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat the process if more than 600 µL of mixture remains for a sample.

steps.title: Wash RNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new collection tube.
Add 400 μl Direct-zol RNA PreWash to the column and centrifuge at 10,000–16,000 × g for 30 seconds.
Discard the flow-through and repeat the 400 μL Direct-zol PreWash step.
Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 700 μl RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10,000–16,000 × g for 2 minutes.
Ensure wash buffer is completely removed, then discard the flow-through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified RNA from the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column carefully into an RNase-free tube.
Add 50 μl of DNase/RNase-Free water directly to the column matrix.
Incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 10,000–16,000 × g.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the extracted RNA according to the intended use timeframe.

substeps.instruction: Keep RNA on ice while in use.
For immediate or short-term use, store in the refrigerator.
For long-term storage, transfer RNA to a new screw-top flat bottom accession labeled microcentrifuge tube and store at -70°C or colder.
